author: AI agent; newly withheld documents, not independently curated human holdout
selection: Two official Samsung 2025 reports not in the existing 2024 development corpus. Four metrics, two statement scopes, current and prior year, quarter and YTD. Same issuer and similar layouts.
gold_method: AI transcribed official PDF cells before running evaluation. Expected arithmetic independently computed with Fraction; source-literal net-profit anomaly retained. No production predictions used for labels.

known_source_anomaly.observation: pypdf text, independent PyMuPDF text and AI inspection of rasterized page agree. Not human reviewed. Do not silently replace printed values.
